title: Classic American Breakfast
description: A hearty breakfast dish made with scrambled eggs, noodles, and a touch of American flavor.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
Whisk together eggs in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the whisked eggs to the skillet and scramble until cooked through.
Serve the scrambled eggs over top of the cooked noodles.
